投稿者: Aseem オーストラリアのPresales Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Try this hidden gem"
良い点: The interface is clean and intuitive. The mobile app remains reliably active with no missed calls or notifications
改善点: Love the audio and the softphone functionality but the video quality in meetings can be improved. It looks like the video quality is only 720p whereas some of the other vendors offer 4K.

タイトル: Program very easy to use at a very accessible price, I love it.
投稿者: Suzi アメリカのProject Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 半導体, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Program very easy to use at a very accessible price, I love it."
良い点: RingCentral MVP combines all of the fundamental requirements for effective communication into a single program that runs on your own computer. Within a single interface, I am able to monitor and respond to incoming phone calls, text messages, faxes, and instantaneous messages from other users.
改善点: The first transition from using a traditional desk phone to a desktop app is one of the drawbacks of RingCentral MVP. No matter where you take your laptop, you can now take your calls with you. Although getting acclimated to it takes a little bit of time, the experience has been positive in general.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very good VOiP"
良い点: The online portal is fantastic. It allows you to divert your calls very easily to a phone or even take them on your computer rather than your desk phone
改善点: We do get several dropouts on desk phones a day Which sometimes makes it frustrating

タイトル: A pretty good office phone system not cost effective at all!
投稿者: James アメリカのBroker, Owner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A pretty good office phone system not cost effective at all!"
良い点: The main things this system does well; call routing, mobile access, voicemail, call transfers.
改善点: This software takes a very long time to set up and get rolled out to the team. This is not cheap and only gets more expensive over time. Their customer service is terrible. I have to search to find out anything on my own. I have tired to schedule numerous meetings with my account manager and usually don't get a reply. The last time we actually got one scheduled he flaked and never called into the meeting. I had my whole team there waiting.

投稿者: Adrian アメリカのProject Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "RingCentral Great For Business"
良い点: Having used a competitor software previously I find that using RingCentral is quick, easy and bug free. It's relatively simple to load on your PC or mobile and does the exact job it is designed to do well.
改善点: Contact management could be improved on RingCentral, but overall, there really isn't much to complain about.

タイトル: Good from far, far from good.
投稿者: Mario カナダのGeneral Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good from far, far from good."
良い点: Initially, it looked good, and it had all the features we wanted. Signed up for it, and once we started doing testing we realized it was not a good fit for us.
改善点: Where do I start? First off, while this may affect Canadian users, whenever we received an incoming call, the CNAM lookup would only show the name of the city the call was originating from. Not the name or the number. After hours of talking to tech support, the only workaround was to turn the CNAM lookup off so we could at least see the number. Getting this half-fast workaround to work was one of the most frustrating experiences of my life. Talking to people a world away and getting them to understand what the issue I was experiencing, including screenshots and videos, felt like talking to a wall. They could not understand why I had an issue with only seeing the name of the city on call display. The tech support kept referring to system limitations whenever they could not solve something. The salesperson has mislead us and told us we could manage multiple lines from one interface. That is not the case. You have to log into each line separately. As a small team, we wanted to have everyone have access to certain lines and be able to jump in on a conversation. That could not be accomplished. This platform was clearly not a good fit for us, but we signed a contract, and made the best of it.

タイトル: Ring Central is a solid small business phone service
投稿者: Rick アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Ring Central is a solid small business phone service"
良い点: We used Ring Central for about a year and it was always pretty good. I really liked the mobile app because it allowed us to work remotely and not have to pay for phone service at our employees homes.
改善点: The phone service only ever had a problem when the internet went down on our office or in my neighborhood. Ring Central was great, the internet was not reliable enough.

投稿者: Darian アメリカのSenior Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Review of Ringcentral"
良い点: Ringcentral gave us a lot of options with a low barrier to entry. We came from an environment with no soft phone capability so the transition was very noticeable. The peer-to-peer communication and peer-to-client communication are both very simple and the call quality is always crystal clear.
改善点: The initial IVR setup for our company was a very drawn out process. We had to hire an external party to create our entire workflow since the built in functionality did not suit our needs. Additionally, we were in the market for a custom API hook that new calls would invoke and the process to get this built in took an extremely long time (6+ months) to add.

タイトル: Very Cost Effecient Way to Provide Seamless Phone Service for Local and Remote Employees
投稿者: Max アメリカのManager, Professional Services & IT 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Very Cost Effecient Way to Provide Seamless Phone Service for Local and Remote Employees"
良い点: RingCentral was very easy to setup for our local office as well as remote employees. We mainly went with RingCentral for this functionality. I could order and ship a phone to a remote employee or set up a phone number for remote employee without them needing a phone and all they would have to do is plug in the phone or log in to RingCentral to get going. Call routing and everything else was seamless to the remote employees.
改善点: There is a bit of a learning curve in configuring the different groups. The customer success team is there to help you get started over the phone and generally available to help whenever needed. It was a bit of a pain to get started, but this was in 2015. It was quite a few emails back and forth with an account rep to get the right plan and block of numbers.

タイトル: RingEx Review from a Daily User
投稿者: Jonathan アメリカのHR and Operations Analyst 非営利団体運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "RingEx Review from a Daily User"
良い点: The idea you can transfer calls to anyone in your organization by just searching them up. The idea of just being able to have a secondary phone on your computer versus a physical phone is so helpful!
改善点: There have been times where it bugged out, and I wasn't receiving a call. Additionally, there were times when the call dropped randomly; however, this might of been to internet problems.

投稿者: Sarah アメリカのAppt Setter 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "I love RingEx"
良い点: I really enjoy having the click to dial ability. I never have outages and rarely does this phone system get flagged as scam (my last one did). I almost never have any type of outage and it was so easy to set up and integrate with my current CRM. When an update caused issues they were very attentive and helpful. Great support! Plus it is the most cost effective one I found!
改善点: Hard to find something not to like! If I had to choose, I have experienced a delay once or twice but that may have been with my internet.

タイトル: AN EXCELLENT APPLICATION FOR BUSINESS COMMUNICATION
投稿者: Marco アメリカのPre Litigation Legal Assistant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 法律サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "AN EXCELLENT APPLICATION FOR BUSINESS COMMUNICATION"
良い点: It allows you to have a single phone number, without having to switch between different numbers. The fact that it also allows me to receive faxes is a great bonus. You can add multiple recipients, even when sending a fax.
改善点: The app sometimes malfunctions when trying to receive return phone calls. Another problem is that the default number selected is sometimes the company's main number and not the user's own number, which makes interaction difficult.

投稿者: Lyla アメリカのAdministrator 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Overall a great phone provider"
良い点: I love that it is an app that I have on my phone so I can call our customers straight from my cell phone. I am also able to message our VA in the Philippines straight from my phone or computer, we use it everyday of the week. We are easily able to record our customer phone calls for proof if something were to come up. The price is great and we are able to add new numbers for a very small price. The app is easy to use and we are able to block spam calls with ease.
改善点: Overall Ring EX has been great. We had a few issues in the beginning setting everything up but Most of those issues are behind us.

投稿者: Milena アメリカのOffice Manager 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ease to use call system"
良い点: RingEX is simple to setup and they do offer multiple options for easy add ons that are both free or even some cheap options to help optimize your phone system. Integrates easily with things including email and has easy communication options.
改善点: The sales team will reach out to you numerous times any time you ask about a change at all to your account.

タイトル: RingEx provides a great small business VOIP service
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "RingEx provides a great small business VOIP service"
良い点: RingEX is very easy to use with a intuitive interface making phone calls and sending faxes very simple. The pricing structure also allow us to get a great value for our business phones.
改善点: The voice to text transcriptions of voicemails sent to my email were not always accurate and led to some misunderstandings with clients. I would definitely recommend actually listening to each voicemail and not relying on the transcription.

タイトル: Decent Meeting Software with Phone System
投稿者: Carolyn アメリカのProject Manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Decent Meeting Software with Phone System"
良い点: They always have some type of promotion going on where you can sign on with a discount. Software has been pretty ease to use and adjust settings.
改善点: I have had all clients struggle when signing on the first few times. This is because Ring Central prompts users to download the app to join the meeting. After waiting for a few seconds, only then it will give the option to join via web browser. Clients will often join the meeting late or not at all because of this, so I started including instructions on how to join through a browser or just use Microsoft Teams instead.

投稿者: Shane アメリカのIT Director 卸売, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Full Communication Suite"
良い点: The best thing about the software is how intuitive and easy to use it is. They didn't try to reinvent the wheel and give you an interface that you've neever seen before. Everything seems to be placed where you would expect it to be and you don't need to constantly dig for information. I also like that over the past few years they have moved all of their apps into one app to make it that much easier.
改善点: I don't like that their used to be more than one application for meetings, calling, and instant messaging. It was tedious to switch between them all. Now that they have merged them all together, it's much better.

タイトル: They saved us from an ancient ShoreTel system, and helped us embrace remote work
投稿者: Ryan アメリカのVP, IT 金融サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "They saved us from an ancient ShoreTel system, and helped us embrace remote work"
良い点: The platform feels modern and robust. I like that end users can install the client without us having to deploy msi's. The sound quality alone on calls was night in day from our onprem system with SIP trunks. We were worried about quality, but it's been a non issue. It's nice having a platform that is constantly improving over time, without us having to shell out more money to prod the vendor to offer more. If you have solid internet connections into your business, you'll be fine.
改善点: The offering was a little on the pricier side compared to competitors. Worth it in my opinion though.

投稿者: Martha アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "RingCentral way better by far!"
良い点: Everything, very friendly software. I love the software.
改善点: A couple of times my text did not go out. But was fixed after I reported the issue.

タイトル: Call, text, fax and conference from anywhere
投稿者: Chirag アメリカのCITO 保険, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Call, text, fax and conference from anywhere"
良い点: RingCentral is a unified communication system. All types of communications stay in a single software. It's great to give a business partner your office number that they could call, text or fax. Video conferencing is easy. RingCentral can be used from a web browser, desktop application, tablet app or a phone app. The unification of all these communication in one spot makes it easy for business partners and customers to work with us.
改善点: RingCentral's video conferencing software and company chat system has opportunities for improvement. Video conference quality is not at par with Zoom. Company chat system is great but not as smooth and elegant as Slack. Those are two areas for improvement.

投稿者: cindy アメリカのmanager 非営利団体運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "ring central is awesome"
良い点: User friendly and easy to set up. Time and money saving
改善点: no refunds on down time, you just have to call your sales team

タイトル: Bloated Software, Not at all Intuitive
投稿者: Lauren アメリカのPresident 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Bloated Software, Not at all Intuitive"
良い点: I liked the ability to access our phone system remotely, but this is no longer a novel tech setup.
改善点: As a business, we were assigned one [SENSITIVE CONTENT] who was incredibly difficult to reach. When attempting to seek out additional assistance as the number given to us was no longer able to reach her, we were told only she would be able to assist us - that we should try emailing once again. As we don't have an abundance of free time with which to chase down our representative, this proved to be frustrating and not at all convenient.

タイトル: Great Tool with many features great for Small Businesses
投稿者: Mattrese アメリカのLeasing Coordinator 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great Tool with many features great for Small Businesses"
良い点: Very easy to navigate, set up for personal features. Love that you can text, fax or place calls on DND or Busy, see the status of other team members if they are busy.
改善点: Some features need to be easier to locate like the "out of office" call forwarding features and setting up voicemail. You have to locate the manual to set these up. Not always the best during a busy work day to look for this set up process.

投稿者: Dawn アメリカのGeneral Manager/Accounts Receivable 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ring Central (the future phone)"
良い点: My favorite pro on Ring Central are all the lines are recorded and there is easy access to pull up those calls. You simply log into your account on ringcentral.com and all calls can be searched by day, time or phone number. You can save the recordings to your computer and send them where applicable. Another pro is the phone has bluetooth capability. I have hooked up my head set to Ring Centrals phone lines several times. You also can easily transfer calls, add a conference call (3-way calling) and put the phone on DND (Do Not Disturb) if busy. My current Ring Central phone has 4 incoming lines available to ring, although I usually only need 2 lines. My first and last name is also on my phone. You can also set up for your phone to have different ring tones for different people and keep a phone book available on the phone for easy access of calling the people you call the most.
改善点: I have found two cons for Ring Central: Since the phone runs off of internet, if the wifi signal goes down, so does the phone. Unfortunately you will need to wait until the wifi connects again for the phone line to become active again. I do believe there is way to hard wire the phone line as well where it is not connected to wifi. The second would be the recorded calls only go back as far as 3 months. Sometimes in business we need to go back a little further than 3 months.

投稿者: Andres コロンビアのRecruitment Manager アウトソーシング、オフショア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excellent tool"
良い点: It is a completely efficient tool; it can be easily used with either a small or large team. It has all kinds of tools useful to keep efficient call tracking, performance log, and analytics.
改善点: I do not consider I have something I do not like from this software at the moment.

投稿者: Flora アメリカのQuality Control Trainer 病院、ヘルスケア, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ms. Auditor"
良い点: The recording and easy to navigate- user friendly and has everything I need
改善点: Nothing so far. I like everything, text, chat, calls and meeting app

タイトル: Product doesn't work and they hold you hostage to your contract
投稿者: matthew アメリカのHead Of Sales コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Product doesn't work and they hold you hostage to your contract"
良い点: It was easy to install the out of the box phone system. Which isn't an MVP product for anyone. It's nuts and bolts without the bolts.
改善点: Entire companies lack of transparency, ability to hold meetings, and overall professionalism.

タイトル: Ring Central - Easier to control the call flows
投稿者: Stephanie カナダのOffice Administration 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ring Central - Easier to control the call flows"
良い点: It means when I'm working from home I am able to transfer calls to other employees who might also be working from home or I can forward the system to our on call staff so much easier than if I had tried to forward each phone individually.
改善点: The beginning was a little difficult for set up, it takes a while to understand (Or it did for me!) but once I understood everything it was so easy to get going.

タイトル: Ring Central as a leading provider for UCaaS solutions
投稿者: Dennisse アメリカのOperations Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ring Central as a leading provider for UCaaS solutions"
良い点: RC is a well know and trusted software brand. Their software is easy to use, setup, customize and deploy.
改善点: I have nothing to not like about this software except I certainly think the look and feel of the actual desktop application can be improved.

タイトル: RingCentral MVP is great for internal collaboration
投稿者: Sarah アメリカのCEO コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "RingCentral MVP is great for internal collaboration"
良い点: It was easy to install, and it is easy to use.
改善点: The customer service department is improving but it still takes a long time to resolve issues. There is a lot of waiting on hold for unimportant tasks.

タイトル: Un risparmio aziendale per i team remoti
投稿者: Simone イタリアのCISUP Director 高等教育, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Un risparmio aziendale per i team remoti"
良い点: RingCentral MVP è stato un punto di svolta per il nostro team remoto. La funzione di registrazione delle chiamate è stata incredibilmente utile per scopi di formazione. Possiamo effettuare trasferimenti senza soluzione di continuità ad altri membri del team con l'opzione "Chiedi prima", che non è disponibile in altre app. La linea aziendale condivisa e le estensioni private sono un enorme vantaggio.
改善点: L'app del telefono nativa può squillare sull'app RingCentral, causando confusione.

投稿者: Jacquelyn アメリカのReceptionist メンタルヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Outstanding"
良い点: RingCentral is pretty easy to use and having to use it for Efax as well and our calls to be timestamped.
改善点: There really isn't anything to complain about it since it has been great since I have been using it.

投稿者: Naïka ドミニカ共和国のInterpreter 認証済みLinkedInユーザー メンタルヘルスケア, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Nai"
良い点: Really great app overall! I enjoyed using it
改善点: There s nothing I can say I don’t like!!

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Ringcentral quick review"
良い点: That it was all about just 1 click, the info about a person I needed to call about selling stuff was already automatically input in the software.
改善点: The price was a bit too high and you could only use the softphone per 2 persons, so literally not the whole team, eh.

タイトル: Whether using desktop/mobile app, a browser or an actual phone, RingCentral has you covered.
投稿者: Michael アメリカのHelp Desk Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Whether using desktop/mobile app, a browser or an actual phone, RingCentral has you covered."
良い点: I'm not sure how much more robust the software could possibly be. We use RingCentral in-house as well as resell it and if it isn't top tier UCaaS, I don't know what is.
改善点: There is a wide dearth between the mobile or desktop apps and the browser application in terms of functionality. This isn't necessarily a bad thing as for most users, the lion's share of their interaction with RingCentral would likely either be via a desktop phone or on a computer screen; but I don't often have need to launch the app in the browser and do most of my work from my mobile device anyway. So as an admin, my ability to oversee the account is limited in those contexts.

投稿者: Becca アメリカのRecruitment Consultant 人材派遣、人材紹介, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "VoIP Void of Value"
良い点: The biggest pro for this software is that VoIP really eliminates any kind of worry about the power going out, or being tied to a desk in order to do your work/take your calls. The other nice thing is that this suite of products via the VoIP service provides you with a phone number to utilize for work purposes (yes, even texting!) - which means no giving out your personal phone number for candidates and clients to utilize!
改善点: This software has literally 3 separate apps you have to use on a computer in order to call, send messages to people from outside your organization, and to send messages to your team internally. Plus, a fourth for video conference meetings. It's arguably one of the most convoluted systems I've ever personally come across. The system also frequently times out on its service (even though they recommend testing your internet/router bandwith for the VoIP, and mine is great) and other features. Often messages will go out, but not in, or vice versa. Sometimes the software will completely seize up and quit, or will get stuck. I've had it ring for 5 minutes straight with no one calling me, forcing me to restart my entire computer.

タイトル: Spotty service will not allow termination of contract under any circumstances
投稿者: Joshua アメリカのConsultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Spotty service will not allow termination of contract under any circumstances"
良い点: When it works I can make phone calls. Voice mail is decent
改善点: We have used them for a year. We have regular intermittent outages with our phones for brief periods. Not the end of the world I suppose but certainly far worse service than you get from traditional services. They recently ran fiber to our business so obviously we are changing over. Phone lines are included in our fiber plan so we no longer need ringcentral. They will not allow us to terminate our plan early or even reduce our services or stop renting the equipment. They are going to bill us for services we no longer use or need. Very unprofessional.

投稿者: Liza アメリカのAdministrative Assistant 医療業務, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "texting!!!"
良い点: Calls are easy to make and forward to other extensions.
改善点: We haven't been able to text in 3 months!!!!! Our TCR application has been jumping back and forth between being Denied and Pending. Every time we call RingCentral, they tell us they can't do anything about it except expedite the application (them expediting it is equal to us waiting 3 months to find out that it was denied for some undecipherable reason). Please heed this warning if you plan to buy RingCentral services. I have been better able to help myself with their services than if I were to call them to help me out. We paid for call and texting services yet we're only receiving calling services. Not only have we lost a lot of business due to not being able to text, but we also are paying more on our RingCentral bills than ever before. DON'T SIGN UP TO RINGCENTRAL IF YOU VALUE TEXTING.

タイトル: The future of small business phone systems
投稿者: Ashlie アメリカのHolistic Health Practitioner / Personal Trainer / Essential Oil Expert 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The future of small business phone systems"
良い点: Not only does this software use my number, I have an additional number as well as fax capabilities. It also has text capabilities and the RingCentral features like RC meetings and Glip. It can be used through a softphone, computer, or cell phone/tablet. All of this costs as much as I was previously paying for one line through our phone company.
改善点: It can be a pain when needing to use it on another computer. I have to go into the website, deactive the other computer to use it on the one I am on at the time. It's an extra step that takes time that I usually don't have.

タイトル: Ringcentral not as easy as it appears to be.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ringcentral not as easy as it appears to be."
良い点: I like that this product allows me to easily share my screen and record the screen sharing for meetings that I have daily with clients.
改善点: About half of the clients who try to log in have trouble at some point. Some of these clients are never able to login. Me personally I have had no problem with the software but for those non-tech savvy clients it has been an ongoing issue.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 政府機関, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Ring Central Review"
良い点: I like the multiple functions of the system that act as a real telephone.

The ability to create multiple greetings depending on if there is someone there to take the call, the time of day, if you are open or closed, or gone on vacation. I'm certain that RingCentral is more than most small businesses will ever use, but enough to take care of nearly every telephone need.
改善点: There is no way to maintain a useful database for your customers. Although there is a Contact feature, it's very basic. This Software would be a home-run if it had a useful database feature. For example, when a call comes in, it would be able to pull up a customers record on-screen that could be edited while speaking to the customer. It would also be useful to be able to import a CVS file to capture existing customers.

タイトル: Reliable, but the price and contracts ruin it.
投稿者: Brandon アメリカのowner 家電製品, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable, but the price and contracts ruin it."
良い点: It's reliable voip service with a decent amount of features.
改善点: Their contracts are a joke. The taxes and fees are too. I overpay. I told them with 6 months left on my contract I didn't want to renew and wanted it to go month to month. about 8 months later I call to cancel (cant do anything online, every support option about billing they make you call your monthly rotating account manager) and was told my contract renewed. Cost to break contract? 100% of remaining contract.

良い点: A very compact user interface, easy to use and no bugs, seamless CRM integration

タイトル: Should Have Started my Business with Ring Central

改善点: Haven't really stumbled upon any weaknesses. Maybe the need to call support when I couldn't figure out how to set something up myself? Hasn't happened often and support has always been great.

投稿者: Trevor アメリカのProduction Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great for Start-Ups"
良い点: I used RingCentral when I first opened my old business. I needed a VOIP phone system that let customers know that they were dealing with a professional company, regardless of how small our staff was. RingCentral did that, and made me look like a great service provider before I ever even spoke to our customers. I would recommend this service to anyone starting a business.
改善点: I honestly can't think of a single thing that I didn't like about this software.

タイトル: Does the job. As long as everything is set up, there shouldn't be many more problems.
投稿者: Grace アメリカのMarketer 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Does the job. As long as everything is set up, there shouldn't be many more problems."
良い点: - Able to download the call recordings - Able to see calls for the past 60 days - Shows Caller ID for the people who called the number
改善点: - Unable to download the voice messages along with the call recordings - You have to know to choose "Extension" and not "Admin Portal" in order to find the voice messages - Sometimes the calls don't get transferred over to the number at the office, so there can be many missed calls at one point

タイトル: One of the best phone system
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "One of the best phone system"
良い点: What I love about this phone system is you can have customers text message you! I’ve never had that with any phone company.
改善点: Don’t hate anything about it. The company is easy to work with.

投稿者: Nupur カナダのRecruitment 人材, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good Software"
良い点: The ease of use and deployment and also that the app works very well
改善点: The text feature was not great initially but later it worked fine

投稿者: Harrison アメリカのCustomer Success 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Moderately easy-to-use Phone Software"
良い点: We make frequent use of the RingCentral desktop softphone applet in office. The applet works pretty well! This applet is probably the sole reason I like RingCentral as much as I do. Its easy to navigate, dial phone numbers, set yourself away, and transferring is a breeze.
改善点: To name a few: -Round Robin is really the only scalable phone support option. You can sorta make multiple phones ring at the same time, but only in small groups. Essentially, you cannot set up a "ring everyone at the same time" style of phone. I suppose this isn't a big deal for some, but its definitely a downer for us. -The actual website. Navigating and dealing with phone settings and administration related tasks is not easy. Unless you read the knowledge center or know how to do it already, it takes a LOT of clicking around to familiarize yourself with where things are or what certain features are or even what those features may be called. -Not every option is available to change or toggle on the desktop softphone applet, meaning unless you know exactly what needs to be set up and how, it can take a while of clicking and navigating menus until you understand where options live and how to use them.
